character: A two-mountain resort in Vermont's Mad River Valley (Lincoln Peak and Mount Ellen, linked by a long chairlift), owned by Alterra Mountain Company, with a mix of groomed runs and natural-snow tree and steep terrain.
learning: Reference note: ski school and rentals operate at Lincoln Peak. Learning-area details were not researched — confirm at source.

season.notes: No resort-announced 2026-27 opening or closing date found as of 2026-09-30. OnTheSnow projects Nov 21, 2026 (a third-party projection, not an announcement). Past opening dates were not captured, so no estimated window is derived.

prices.note: Aggregator (snowstash.com): 2026/27 adult day tickets from $135 to $195 depending on date and advance purchase. An OnTheSnow listing showed $129 weekday / $199 weekend with no season stated.

research.confidenceNotes: Partly researched on 2026-09-30 (search summaries). Terrain (581 acres, 111 runs, 15–16 lifts) and 2026-27 prices (aggregator $135–$195; official TBD $99 and Quad Pack $109/ticket) are search-summary facts. Identity, coordinates, elevations, operator and the few features set remain Piste reference data. The OnTheSnow date is a projection; drive/airport times are Piste estimates; pass access was not re-researched.
